descriptions.google/adk-python#7663: `FirestoreSessionService` returned every user's sessions for an empty user id
descriptions.google/adk-python#7729: An expired OAuth2 token with no refresh token crashed the tool
descriptions.google/adk-python#7665: Failed MCP tool results reached Claude marked as successes
descriptions.google/adk-python#7476: `ApigeeLlm` dropped text sent alongside a function response
descriptions.google/adk-python#7479: Artifacts saved in agent callbacks were never recorded
descriptions.google/adk-python#7499: A workflow `JoinNode` inside a loop fired with the previous iteration's outputs
descriptions.google/adk-python#7991: Resuming a workflow re-ran a node that was still waiting for output
descriptions.ml-explore/mlx#4663: `layer_norm` and SDPA fallbacks ignored the caller's stream (C++ core)
descriptions.Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm#2486: The Anthropic-compatible stream sent text past `stop_sequences`
descriptions.Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm#2492: Multi-turn Phi-3-vision / Phi-4-MM chats with images crashed
descriptions.Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm#2473: The Eagle3 speculative-decoding drafter failed without its own embeddings
descriptions.Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm#2476: PaddleOCR-VL LoRA training didn't freeze the vision encoder and rejected packed patches
descriptions.NVIDIA/NeMo-Agent-Toolkit#2476: MCP service-account tokens had a timezone-naive expiry, so no credentials were sent
descriptions.strands-agents/harness-sdk#5016: Warnings were logged for every earlier message on every request (N² log lines)

highlights.AWS SageMaker Python SDK: Bugs in the v3 SDK across training, serving, pipelines and core, such as a KMS key sent as a customer encryption key, `mpirun -np` given the wrong rank count, and `AsyncPredictor` hanging instead of timing out
highlights.Ollama: Responses API text dropped next to tool calls, blobs not pruned after pull or copy, a race in blob-download cancellation
highlights.Tesla: Vehicle wake-up polling, cabin overheat protection level, Kafka client errors, statsd tags, `FixedBitset` construction
highlights.MLX-VLM: Qwen3-VL embedding position IDs, GLM-OCR image input, pooling options
highlights.Google ADK: Workflow resume replay, keeping finished parallel tool results on abort
highlights.Anthropic Claude Agent SDK: A client disconnect race, recursive TypedDict schemas for MCP tools
highlights.NVIDIA: Reproducible seeded prompts in garak, empty trailing slices in Warp
